desc: The farm building pass (docs/decisions/0004-farm-building.md). Farm level is points from play; items unlock by farm level or a milestone; new buildings are construction sites that you hammer (hold interact) and your Boki help build; the materials are spent a quarter at a time as the work goes; buildings upgrade L1 to L3. Units: gems and materials are counts, labour is work swings (one hammer beat of yours is 0.8 s, one swing of a Boki is about 3 s at building skill 1).
base_mode_doc: GARDEN.md section 8: true shrinks the farm to the Boki base. Build mode shows only Buildings, Garden and Island; no axe, pickaxe or wild chopping; no work stations, wild or haul jobs (Boki knacks still run the plot, mend and incubator chores); no Exchange, Sell tab, tools or crop-chain goods at the market; meals lean a Boki by the food's type (content/rules/lean.json, Lean) instead of the four affinities. Nothing is deleted: false changes nothing, and saves are untouched either way.
points_doc: Farm points = sum(stat * weight). 'built' counts the lot buildings you built, 'fb_built' the buildings Boki finished on the farm.
levels_doc: Points needed for farm level 1..6 (index 0 is level 1).

first_extract.name: First extraction
first_extract.text: Make it out of an expedition once

first_boss.name: First boss
first_boss.text: Defeat a boss in a lair

scan3.name: Three scanned
scan3.text: Scan and bring home 3 wild Boki

water.tip: Within 2 tiles of water, a crop patch waters itself.
water.doc: A crop patch whose footprint is within reach tiles of water (a pond, a painted river or the wild water) tends its own plots (FarmWater).

lots_doc: Wood and stone a building LOT costs on a farm under the building pass, instead of its gem price in Data.BUILDINGS (the Challenge House: Hob draws it up after the first expedition).
starter_doc: Placed at once, no site. The house is not here: it goes up as a site you and your Boki build (build.house): 10 wood and 6 stone, spent as it goes up.
start_doc: What Hob offers from the first minute is every item with no entry in unlock: house, crop_patch, cook_pot, ranch_pen, fence, path_dirt, flowers (and the feeder in storage). Everything in unlock opens by farm level or milestone and is then drawn up when you talk to Hob (scripts/home/farm_builder.gd).
cradles_doc: Incubator cradle number -> farm level that lets you buy it.
upgrade_doc: Cost to reach tier 2 and tier 3. 'level' is the farm level it needs. Work stations work 25% / 50% faster at L2 / L3.
